hook: Words carry speech at the lowest bitrate, with slightly longer units sometimes doing better.
hook_turn: with slightly longer units sometimes doing better.
summary: Using 960 hours of transcribed English audiobooks, the study compares how many bits per second are needed to encode speech as phones, syllables, words, and multi-word chunks. Both n-gram and transformer language models were used under limited capacity. Results come from one language and read speech, and depend on the modeling budget chosen.
title: On the information rate of phones, syllables and words
